The 109 planned products (lp_run 6): stock at the 2 March 2026 count over the 3 February count, times
figures.query: WITH plan AS ( SELECT lr.product_key, lr.rop_i, fr.forecast_value FROM lp_recommendation lr JOIN forecast_result fr ON fr.product_key = lr.product_key AND fr.forecast_date = lr.planning_cycle_date WHERE lr.planning_cycle_date = DATE '2026-03-01' AND lr.lp_run_key = 6 ), stock AS ( SELECT inv._period, inv.product_key, SUM(inv.quantity_on_hand) * pd.pack_size::numeric + COALESCE(SUM(inv.quantity_pieces), 0) AS pieces FROM inventory_fact_real inv JOIN plan ON plan.product_key = inv.product_key JOIN product_dimension pd ON pd.product_key = inv.product_key WHERE inv._period IN ('2026-01', '2026-02', '2026-03') GROUP BY inv._period, inv.product_key, pd.pack_size ), counts(period) AS (VALUES ('2026-01'), ('2026-02'), ('2026-03')) SELECT counts.period, COUNT(*) AS products, SUM(COALESCE(stock.pieces, 0)) AS stock_pieces, SUM(GREATEST(0, plan.forecast_value + plan.rop_i - COALESCE(stock.pieces, 0))) AS requirement_pieces FROM counts CROSS JOIN plan LEFT JOIN stock ON stock._period = counts.period AND stock.product_key = plan.product_key GROUP BY counts.period ORDER BY counts.period
